analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has entered oversold territory, and the ADX trend remains weak. analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 52,175) vs SMA5 (KRW 58,136) / SMA20 (KRW 65,446) / SMA50 (KRW 87,038): Diagnosis of short- to mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 106,964) / SMA200 (KRW 112,878): Assessment of long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (6.7%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.2→32.5) + Oversold diagnosis + Continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -609.9491→3.0720) + Improvement diagnosis + Weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at KRW 49,182) + Bandwidth interpreted at 49.70% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 51,065) + Basis (based on 20-day low).
· Swing resistance (KRW 80,380) + Expectation of mid-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day / 20-day high-low pattern (sideways) + Lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.98x vs 5-day average) + Moderate reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + Entry conditions: Confirmation of RSI recovery above 50 and MACD golden cross.
